label: India (FSSAI)
visualChecklist: Veg (green) or non-veg (brown) symbol: a filled circle or triangle inside a square, in the right colour, close to the product name, at the minimum size for the panel
Official FSSAI logo with the licence number printed beside it, on the primary pack (not a sticker)
Net quantity and MRP numerals meet the minimum height for the principal display panel's area (Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011)
Mandatory declarations are legible, on a contrasting background, and not covered by seals or flaps
Nutritional information is in a table, per 100 g or 100 ml and per serve

rules.name: Claim to prevent, treat or cure a disease
rules.citation: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006; FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018
rules.aiGuidance: Flag wording that says or implies the food prevents, treats, cures, manages or alleviates a specific disease or medical condition (or a symptom of one), or that it is meant for people who have one. Food labels in India may not make such claims. Flag, for example: "helps manage diabetes", "controls blood pressure", "prevents heart disease", "good for diabetics", "cures joint pain". Do NOT flag wording about supporting normal, healthy body function that names no disease, condition or symptom: "supports healthy blood sugar", "supports immunity", "builds strong bones", "high protein". Tie-break: if the wording does not name a disease, condition or symptom, and does not say the food is for people who have one, do not flag it.

rules.name: Allergen not declared
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 (declaration of food allergens)

rules.name: FSSAI licence number missing
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: FSSAI logo and licence number on the label
rules.explanation: No 14-digit FSSAI licence number was found. Every packaged food label in India needs the FSSAI logo and licence number, printed on the pack (not a sticker).
rules.advice: Print your 14-digit FSSAI licence number next to the FSSAI logo.

rules.name: FSSAI number structure looks wrong
rules.citation: FSSAI 14-digit licence / registration number format (FoSCoS): type digit, state code, year, office, business number
rules.explanation: A wrong licence number on the pack means a reprint. The structure is a quick sanity check; only FoSCoS can confirm the number is real.
rules.advice: Copy the number exactly from your FSSAI licence certificate and look it up on foscos.fssai.gov.in.

rules.name: Veg or non-veg mark not mentioned
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: vegetarian / non-vegetarian symbol
rules.explanation: The label text doesn't mention the veg (green) or non-veg (brown) mark. It's a symbol, so it may be on your artwork already: check that it sits close to the product name.
rules.advice: Make sure the green (veg) or brown (non-veg) symbol is printed next to the product name.

rules.name: Net quantity missing
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: net quantity declaration
rules.explanation: No net quantity (for example "Net quantity: 200 g") was found. Packaged goods sold in India must declare it.
rules.advice: Add the net quantity in standard units, e.g. "Net quantity: 200 g".

rules.name: MRP missing
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: retail sale price (MRP, inclusive of all taxes)
rules.explanation: No MRP was found. Packaged goods sold in India must show the maximum retail price, "inclusive of all taxes".
rules.advice: Add "MRP ₹[amount] (incl. of all taxes)".

rules.name: Best-before or use-by date missing
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 and Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: best before / use by
rules.explanation: No best-before or use-by date was found. Indian food labels must show it, and online channels use it to check shelf life.
rules.advice: Add the best-before period, e.g. "Best before 6 months from manufacture".

fix.line: Best before: [number of months] months from manufacture

rules.name: Manufacturer name and address missing
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: name and address of the manufacturer or packer
rules.explanation: No manufacturer, packer or marketer name and address was found.
rules.advice: Add "Manufactured by: [name and full address]".

fix.line: Manufactured by: [manufacturer name and full address]

rules.name: "Natural" claim on a multi-ingredient food
rules.citation: FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018: use of "natural"
rules.explanation: "Natural" is reserved for single foods with nothing added. A product made from several ingredients may only say "made from natural ingredients".
rules.advice: Change it to "made from natural ingredients", or remove the word.

rules.name: Product name missing
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: name of the food
rules.explanation: No product name was found. The label must give the name of the food.
rules.advice: Add the product's name to the front panel.

rules.name: Ingredient list missing
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: list of ingredients in descending order of weight
rules.explanation: No ingredient list ("Ingredients: …") was found. Without it, allergens can't be checked either.
rules.advice: Add "Ingredients:" followed by every ingredient in descending order by weight.

rules.name: Additive declared without functional class or INS number
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: food additives declared by functional class, followed by their name or INS number
rules.explanation: FSSAI wants food additives declared by functional class and then their name or INS number, e.g. "Emulsifier (INS 322(i))". If it is used as an ordinary ingredient rather than an additive, you can ignore this.
rules.advice: Declare it as "Functional class (INS number)".

rules.name: Nutritional information missing
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: nutritional information per 100 g or 100 ml and per serve
rules.explanation: No nutritional information table was found in the text.
rules.advice: Paste the nutritional information table (per 100 g or 100 ml, and per serve).

rules.name: Nutrition not given per 100 g / 100 ml (or per pack) and per serve
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: values per 100 g or 100 ml, or per single consumption pack, and per serve with % RDA
rules.explanation: The nutrition table doesn't show values per 100 g (or 100 ml, or per pack for a single-serve pack) and per serve.
rules.advice: Give each nutrient per 100 g or 100 ml (a single-serve pack may use per pack instead) and per serve, with % RDA per serve.

rules.name: MRP doesn't say "inclusive of all taxes"
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: MRP declared "inclusive of all taxes"
rules.explanation: The MRP is printed, but without the words "inclusive of all taxes".
rules.advice: Write it as "MRP ₹[amount] (incl. of all taxes)".

rules.name: Consumer care details missing
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: consumer care name, address, phone and email
rules.explanation: No consumer care contact (phone or email) was found.
rules.advice: Add "Customer care: [phone] | [email]" with the person or office to contact.

fix.line: Customer care: [customer care phone] | [customer care email]

rules.name: Country of origin missing
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6: country of origin or manufacture
rules.explanation: No country of origin was found, and no manufacturer address in India. Imported food must say where it was made; for food made in India, the Indian manufacturer address shows it.
rules.advice: Add "Country of origin: India" (or the country it was made in).

rules.name: Batch or lot number missing
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: lot, code or batch identification
rules.explanation: No batch or lot number was found. It's usually printed at packing time, so a placeholder is fine on artwork.
rules.advice: Leave a space on the artwork for "Batch No.", printed at packing.

fix.line: Batch No.: [batch number, printed at packing]

rules.name: Date of manufacture or packing missing
rules.citation: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, Rule 6 and FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020: date of manufacture or packing
rules.explanation: No date of manufacture or packing was found. Quick-commerce and online channels use it with the best-before date to work out shelf life.
rules.advice: Add "Mfd. on: [month/year]", printed at packing.

rules.name: Placeholder still on the label
rules.citation: FSS (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020 and Legal Metrology Rule 6: declarations must state the real values
rules.explanation: This is a placeholder, not a real value. A required declaration with a placeholder is still missing.
rules.advice: Replace it with the real value (Fix all has a form for this).

rules.name: Nutrient claim without a nutrition line
rules.citation: FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018: a nutrient content claim needs the nutrient's amount in the nutritional information
rules.explanation: The label makes a nutrient claim, but the nutrition table has no line for that nutrient to back it up.
rules.advice: Add this nutrient's amount per 100 g / 100 ml to the nutritional information, or remove the claim.

rules.name: Nutrient claim doesn't meet the threshold
rules.citation: FSS (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018, Schedule I. Thresholds here follow Codex per 100 g / 100 ml and still need checking against Schedule I
rules.explanation: The nutrition table doesn't support this claim's threshold.
rules.advice: Reformulate to meet the threshold, or use a weaker claim (e.g. "source of") or none.

rules.name: Barcode check digit is wrong
rules.citation: GS1 General Specifications: Modulo-10 check digit for EAN-13 and UPC-A (GTIN-13 / GTIN-12)
rules.explanation: A barcode with the wrong check digit won't scan at checkout or at a marketplace warehouse.
rules.advice: Copy the GTIN exactly from your GS1 account and regenerate the barcode artwork from it.
